channel.title: Jinn OS — Devlog & Microkernel Releases
channel.description: Atualizações técnicas, benchmarks de latência SIMD/AVX2, post-mortems e releases do microkernel bare-metal x86_64 em Rust (jinn-os.dev.br).

item.title: Post-Mortem: Como o EOI Incondicional no PIC 8259A e o Motor Zero-GPU Viabilizaram 0.00% de CPU em Repouso
item.description: Auditoria aprofundada sobre a eliminação de congelamentos de interrupção (IRQs 1 e 12) via EOI incondicional no PIC mestre e escravo, combinada com a arquitetura Zero-GPU do JHCS (AVX2/FMA sem alocações no laço quente), atingindo o Rank 1 de eficiência energética com 0.00% de CPU em repouso absoluto.

item.title: feat(kernel,jhcs,web): zero-idle allocation, PCI audio driver, browser evolution, and JHCS strategic issues
item.description: - Drivers & Interrupts: Add PCI AC97 / Intel HDA driver with page-aligned DMA buffers and storm protection; shield PIC cascade line (IRQ 2) and PS/2 mouse (IRQ 12). - Scheduler & Syscalls: Enforce strict Zero-Idle policy; blocked tasks consume 0% CPU; implement blocking event polling (syscalls 22/24) with immediate unblock on compositor dispatch. - Aladdin & GUI: Implement active garbage collection for client window backbuffers (freeing 3 MiB on close/minimize). - Jinn Browser: Add external CSS stylesheet support via VFS (/disk/STYLE.CSS), rich tag/class/id styling, and reactive MiniJsRuntime with DOM manipulation on click events. - JHCS Strategic Issues: Add 6 structured contributor issues in docs/strategic-issues/ and publishing script scripts/publish_strategic_issues.ps1. - Web & Landing Page: Add 'Contribute to Jinn Edge & JHCS' card in Whisker menu and terminal routing for 'jhcs' and 'issues' commands.
